## 4. Re-running the checks yourself

```bash
# re-fetch every URL in this document and report what resolves
python3 scripts/verify_links.py

# only the citations for one merchant or entry id
python3 scripts/verify_links.py --filter costco

# fail if something outside the documented link-rot log breaks
python3 scripts/verify_links.py --strict

# enforce the sourcing rules mechanically
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
```

The weekly GitHub Actions run (`.github/workflows/verify.yml`) repeats the link check every Monday and files a `link-rot` issue when a citation outside the documented log stops resolving.
